name: high-speed-preview-braking-v1
purpose: replace the conservative clear-straight pace with a generic preview-conditioned longitudinal speed envelope that accelerates hard on verified straights and brakes before and through visible curves

evidence.finding: All three latest videos finish without a visible progress plateau, but launch and general progress are slow. The routed controller confirms a conservative cruise target48 and clear-straight gas ceiling0.11. Reaching23.0 seconds would require reductions of15.4,30.8 and24.8 percent respectively, so the low-20-second range is an objective rather than an established outcome.
evidence.interpretation: Primary sources support a curvature-limited speed profile with forward acceleration and backward braking logic. Camera-row sweep is not metric curvature or distance, so the implementation is a bounded proxy and not a physics-optimal velocity solution.

single_factor.name: preview-conditioned longitudinal speed envelope
single_factor.bundling_reason: Raising straight speed without moving braking earlier is predictably unsafe; straight acceleration, curve target and braking feedback form one longitudinal envelope. Steering, perception and obstacle routing remain frozen so the factor stays longitudinal-only.
single_factor.fast_gas_gate: exact inherited straight; no current obstacle; obstacle miss latch fully clear; brake zero; abs(previous steering)<=0.07
single_factor.curve_proxy: derive sweep from the raw inherited curve target before EMA as max(0,(68-curve_target_speed)/2); this is algebraically identical to the frozen generic visible-road sweep and uses no track or seed identity
unchanged: road and obstacle perception, steering law, steering limits and slew
obstacle side, urgency, curve-retention, distant preview and preview-to-obstacle priority state
lost-road behavior, observation/action interface and official environment files
model.pt, DrQ, explicit-export and HAIC policy routes
all track-id, seed, coordinate, elapsed-time and progress independence

safety_priority: Current obstacle and obstacle miss latch always veto high-speed straight gas.
A visible curve immediately bypasses the stale-target EMA for the emitted longitudinal command; its target never exceeds48 and reaches30 by sweep7.34.
A current obstacle is immediately capped at47 or40 by image distance, and obstacle plus sweep>=6 is capped at30; the cap persists through the miss latch.
Gas and brake are mutually exclusive, brake remains at most0.28, and invalid/lost-road behavior remains inherited.
Steering must be bit-exact to the control for identical observations and state.

static_and_synthetic: Bare state-dict routing selects only the candidate; explicit export, DrQ and HAIC routes remain unchanged.
On settled, obstacle-free clear straights, speed branches emit exactly0.18/0.135/0.09 gas and use target68; gas above0.11 is impossible outside the registered gate.

A distant bend following repeated fast-straight frames immediately lowers the command target and brakes; a sustained/mid curve continues braking while overspeed; mirrored curves have identical longitudinal actions.
Curve target exact and nextafter boundaries at sweep1.5, the30/48 clips, speed target+0.5 and pedal branch transitions are closed.
Current obstacle, all miss-latch frames, reacquisition, invalid input, road loss and reset never receive fast gas; obstacle caps and compound cap apply immediately.
Randomized actions are finite and bounded, never combine gas and brake, keep steering exact to control and differ longitudinally only under the registered envelope.
Affected/local/submission contract tests and an isolated exact-file package smoke pass.

future_environment_gate.required_before_claim: After governance restoration, preregister unused multi-track geometry seeds and compare to the exact control. Completion rate, DNF, collision and worst-progress may not regress before lap time is considered.
future_environment_gate.objective: Move each evaluation-video track toward the low-20-second range; no static implementation or consumed video can establish that result.

abort: Any runtime condition uses track id, seed, map identity, coordinate, time, progress or evaluation filename.
Any steering/perception/obstacle pass-side behavior changes or any fast gas appears during a curve, obstacle, latch, invalid input or road loss.
Any action is non-finite/out of range, gas and brake overlap, package/interface gate fails, or relevant regression fails.
Any environment execution, training, submission, SOTA promotion or performance claim occurs while governance documents remain absent.
Any frozen environment/model/DrQ/active-study artifact, user video or root submission.zip changes.
compliance_blockers: SOTA.md, RESULTS.md, COMPETITION_INFO.md, RESTRICTIONs.md and report.pdf are absent.
The competition website is inaccessible; the official participant repository remains available and unchanged.
Only source, synthetic, unit and isolated package validation is authorized.
